description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Starfield' that renders an animated, parallax starfield using HTML5 Canvas. It manages animation state with refs, handles window resize events to adjust the starfield, and draws multiple layers of stars with different densities, sizes, opacities, and velocities to create a depth effect.

methods.name: Starfield({ speed = 1, density = 1, color = '#ffffff' })
methods.description: React functional component that renders the animated starfield canvas.

methods.name: buildStars()
methods.description: Initializes star objects for each layer based on current size and density.

methods.name: makeLayer(count, W, H, params)
methods.description: Creates an array of star objects with randomized positions, sizes, opacities, and velocities for a layer.

methods.name: draw(dt)
methods.description: Clears the canvas and draws each star layer with movement based on time delta.

methods.name: drawLayer(ctx, layer, dt, layerSpeedScale, colorHex, W, H)
methods.description: Draws all stars in a layer, updating their positions and wrapping when passing bottom.

methods.name: hexToRgb(hex)
methods.description: Converts a hex color string to an RGB object.

methods.name: rand(a, b)
methods.description: Returns a random number within a given range.
